verdict.rationale: Square provides Webhooks for event notifications and an API/SDK ecosystem that developers could use to build automated event-triggered rules, but there is no first-party 'rules engine' or automation/workflow builder documented that lets users declaratively define trigger-action rules. missing for 10: a native rules/automation builder UI or API, documented trigger-action templates, and evidence of end-to-end automation beyond raw webhook events requiring custom code.
